summary: Space Angel received a $1.75 million grant from the Western Australian Government to advance its spaceport plans. The funding was announced by Science and Innovation Minister Stephen Dawson.

summary: Tendeg unveiled NewTEN, a two-axis steerable reflector antenna designed to enhance communications performance and pointing access for small spacecraft. The product was launched at the SmallSat event in Salt Lake City.

summary: SpaceX and NASA have postponed the Crew-13 mission to the International Space Station due to an oxidizer leak on the Dragon spacecraft. The new launch date has not been set.

title: NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope Launches
summary: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is scheduled to launch aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket on August 30, 2026. The telescope, named after NASA's first chief astronomer, will conduct extensive surveys of stars and galaxies with a significantly wider field of view than the Hubble Space Telescope.

summary: The Roman Space Telescope is on a three-month journey to the Sun-Earth Lagrange Point 2 (L2) and is undergoing commissioning to prepare for science operations. During this phase, systems are activated, adjusted, calibrated, and tested to ensure optimal performance.

title: APOD: 2026 August 31 – Launch of the Roman Space Telescope
summary: The NASA Roman Space Telescope is scheduled for launch on August 31, 2026. This mission aims to advance astronomical research and expand our understanding of the universe.

title: Ribbon-Cutting Event for NASA Deep Space Network’s Deep Space Station 23
summary: NASA held a ribbon-cutting event for the newly completed Deep Space Station 23 antenna at the Deep Space Network’s Goldstone complex in California. The event was attended by leadership from NASA Headquarters, the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, and the Deep Space Network.

summary: NASA's Deep Space Network's Goldstone complex features five 34-meter antennas, including the recently completed Deep Space Station 23, showcased in a panoramic image from August 2026.

summary: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket to study the universe's dark secrets. The mission will spend three months traveling to its final orbit, a million miles away.

summary: NASA's Artemis II crew, including astronauts Victor Glover, Christina Koch, Jeremy Hansen, and Reid Wiseman, received the Congressional Space Medal of Honor from President Donald Trump in 2026 for their contributions to the Artemis II mission.

title: NASA Awards First Prize in Phase 2 of Agency’s LunaRecycle Challenge
summary: NASA awarded MIT's CERBERUZ team the first prize in Phase 2 of the LunaRecycle Challenge for developing a technology to recycle waste materials like fabrics and plastics during lunar or deep space missions. The team received $775,000 for grinding mixed trash into a fine powder for reuse.
